label: The Trainee
summary: A late-signed trainee with a great voice and no idea how to survive an agency.

character.name: Seo-yeon Park
character.description: A twenty-year-old singer discovered busking in a subway station and signed in a week. Talented, untrained and completely unprepared for the agency life.
goals: Send money home to her mother
abilities: A voice that makes people stop walking
